name: A price change seen at checkout appears in the price history
description: The checkout re-check is recorded: the product's history shows the new reading and says the price moved.

planSteps.description: Open /p/nalgene-789703 on this site, click 'Add to cart', then open /checkout
Verify a notice says '32oz Wide Mouth Surrealist Bottles went up from $18.99 to $21.99 since you added it.'
Verify a section headed 'Price history' is shown and its newest reading is '$21.99 · Checked at checkout'. Headings are displayed in capitals by the stylesheet; compare text without regard to case.
Verify a note reads 'Latest store reading: $21.99' and says you'll see the up-to-date price at checkout
Verify the oldest reading is '$18.99 · Store catalogue' dated '23 Oct'
Verify the product's price at the top of the page still reads '$18.99'
